topic: F-V01-13 fixed SQLite runtime product admission boundary
premise_chain: Cycle 4 target-binds the actually loaded Ubuntu SQLite 3.45.1-1ubuntu2.7 object/source lineage and classifies it vulnerable to the targeted WAL-reset defect.
PR #315 target-proves an isolated official SQLite 3.53.4 survives that targeted defect and the existing process-crash oracle.
A fixed private build is not a product solution if a Frank state process can silently resolve back to the vulnerable system object.

hypothesis.claim: A fresh Frank Python state process can be made fail-closed on SQLite runtime identity by hash-pinning an accepted manifest, validating candidate object bytes/version/source-id before pysqlite import, re-execing with the private library path, and validating the actually mapped child-process object before target execution.

strongest_counterhypothesis.claim: LD_LIBRARY_PATH/re-exec is not a reliable admission mechanism for Python pysqlite: the child may still map the target system libsqlite3 object or existing V17 state semantics may regress under the private 3.53.4 runtime.

admission_differential.positive_control: target executes only after child process observes exactly the admitted private 3.53.4 version/source-id/mapped object

architecture_delta.name: FAIL_CLOSED_SQLITE_RUNTIME_OBJECT_ADMISSION
architecture_delta.rule: Correctness-sensitive Frank Python state execution must be admitted against an independently accepted SQLite manifest and then prove the actually mapped object/version/source-id/hash before executing state logic. Accidental fallback to the target system SQLite 3.45.1 object must fail closed.
architecture_delta.provenance_boundary: The existing dpkg-oriented loaded-object probe remains valid only for the system baseline. Private runtime provenance uses immutable artifact/build authority plus manifest hash and child-process mapped-object evidence; do not weaken one provenance model to masquerade as the other.
architecture_delta.rollback: If deployment cannot reproduce immutable build/manifest provenance or the admitted runtime regresses broader state/effect/GWT suites, do not promote; retain system SQLite only for non-WAL/correctness-insensitive paths or fail closed pending a supported fixed package/runtime.

remaining_gates: Promote manifest/build provenance from ephemeral CI output into an immutable accepted deployment artifact/installation boundary.
Run broader presence/V17/GWT/effect-authority suites under the exact admitted 3.53.4 object.
Test recovery across restart while enforcing the same runtime admission.
Keep power-loss/kernel-panic durability separate; SIGKILL/process-crash success is not equivalent evidence.
Do not globally replace the host SQLite package merely from this candidate.
go_oob_experiment: NONE_IN_CYCLE_5; macrocycle OOB slot already consumed in Cycle 1
